a72e569cc5efdadbad7413502815beeb24769f06: A resort on a human scale, Mürren focuses on the quality of its welcome and its closeness rather than on impressive figures. Its 54 km of runs are ideal for a stay of 3 to 4 days, especially for families or skiers who do not need to constantly change their terrain. Mürren's family reputation is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, a well-run childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. With the summit at 2970 m and the village at 796 m, Mürren's snow cover is generally reliable from January to the end of March. A few exceptionally mild winters can create tensions early in the season, but the situation quickly recovers with the first significant snowfalls. A stay in Mürren is clearly expensive: 88€ for a day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants that are among the priciest in the Alps. It is the price of excellence, but you should be aware of it before you set off. In short: Mürren lives up to its promises. A resort in the Northern Alps that will suit most profiles without disappointing.
